title: Sync Reporting Receipts Request
x-tool-summary: Record a consumer's independently verified reporting totals and destination evidence in the seller ledger.
description: Submit durable authenticated consumer reconciliation results for reporting materializations and post-official adjustments. This is a batched idempotent upsert, not an acknowledgement of mere webhook receipt. Identity comes from authenticated transport; the request MUST NOT assert a buyer or governance principal.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated batch key. Exact retries reuse the key and body.

adjustment_receipts.description: Consumer acceptance or rejection of exact post-official adjustments.

x-adcp-validation.batch_identity: reporting_receipt_id values MUST be unique across receipts and adjustment_receipts, whose combined length MUST NOT exceed 100. Every referenced obligation, revision, materialization, and adjustment MUST resolve within the authenticated caller and account or fail with an indistinguishable unavailable result.
x-adcp-validation.partial_results: Each receipt is independent. One failed result does not roll back successfully recorded receipts; retries use the same receipt IDs and content.
